scenarios.title: Securities trade confirmed without evidence of legal title
scenarios.expected: Trade state may advance; ownership posting and finality must remain blocked; unresolved off-balance treatment routed for institution approval.

scenarios.title: Custodian confirms holding but clearing operator returns UNKNOWN
scenarios.expected: Keep separate custody and settlement states; never fabricate finality or duplicate a posting on retry.

scenarios.title: R-2010/03 historical six-month exception requested for a 2026 exposure
scenarios.expected: Reject prudential waiver absent current supersession proof, effective-dated rule and institution approval.

scenarios.title: R-2010/03 Article 2 signature date not legible
scenarios.expected: Do not invent an effective date; keep candidate quarantined pending issuer/qualified legal evidence.

scenarios.title: R-2003/03 original Article 24 used after identified 2010 replacement
scenarios.expected: Reject unqualified old clause; require amendment-chain selection and currentness review.

scenarios.title: I-2015/01 0.5% / 2% provisioning values loaded as current defaults
scenarios.expected: Block release; require verified current rule and source-linked institutional approval.

scenarios.title: I-2015/01 Article 14 cross-reference to R-2014/01 used as proof of 2026 rule
scenarios.expected: Reject inferred current classification; reconcile R-2018/01 and later instruments first.

scenarios.title: Downloaded PDF hash differs from previously approved immutable evidence at same issuer URL
scenarios.expected: Quarantine new binary; retain prior copy; require legal review and release versioning; never overwrite old hash.

scenarios.title: A valid SHA-256 is presented without official publication or institutional approval
scenarios.expected: Reject policy activation; hash proves byte identity only, not legal authority.

scenarios.title: Source acquisition operator self-approves chart and prudential release
scenarios.expected: Reject segregation-of-duties violation, emit tamper-evident audit event, do not post money.

scenarios.title: Historical 2003 securities position reconstructed after 2015 chart amendment
scenarios.expected: Use original effective-dated chart and evidence; any restatement requires distinct controlled journal/reports, not mutation.

scenarios.title: Disaster recovery replays settlement callback twice while custodian outcome unknown
scenarios.expected: Return original idempotency outcome or explicit UNKNOWN; independent reconciliation required; never duplicate posted journal.
